description:
Read what a wallet holds on Robinhood Chain and say, token by token, which contracts use the ticker of an official Stock Token without being it, which hold code Zorvu's check reads as a drainer, which are the official Stock Tokens, and how large a sale the pools took for those.

Useful for telling a holding apart from an impostor of it before anything is signed, and for seeing at once which of a wallet's positions Zorvu has any reading for. `summary.line` is the one-sentence count; `tokens` is every holding, with the lookalikes first.

The wallet is read live and is not stored: Zorvu keeps no record of the address or of the result. The scan reads balances once from the chain and everything else from its own stored readings, so it makes no per-token chain read: a token Zorvu has no reading for comes back with `group: "unknown"`, `drainer_check: null` and no ticker. A null is no reading — never a pass, never zero, and never that the code is clean. Each reading carries the time it was taken and where it came from. Whether a token can be sold at all is not checked here. Balances are raw on-chain integers with no decimals applied, and when the list comes from Transfer logs there is no balance at all and a token the wallet has since sent on can still appear. At most 100 tokens, with `balances.truncated` saying when a wallet held more. These are measurements of public chain data at the time shown, not advice and not a recommendation about any holding.

wallet.description: The wallet address to read, on Robinhood Chain. It is read live and is not stored.

name: scan_wallet

balance.description: The raw on-chain amount as an integer string. A scan does not read the token’s decimals(), so it is not an amount to display without them. null when the list came from Transfer logs, which carry no balance.

drainer_check.description: null means no reading: never that the code is clean.

lookalike_of.description: Set when this contract uses the ticker of an official Stock Token and is not that contract.

sell_depth.description: Only for official Stock Tokens; null for every other token, which Zorvu does not measure depth for.

symbol_source.description: Where the ticker came from: the official registry, a stored contract check under a day old, or an archived reading with its date. A scan makes no live ticker read.

title: Scan a wallet
